name: ARCHITECT
summary: Deep-module architecture discipline: design each module to expose a small interface over a large implementation, place it at a clean seam, and make it testable through that interface.
prevents: Ball-of-mud codebases — shallow modules, leaking internals, and AI-accelerated entropy that makes every change risky.

cursor.rule_description: Use when designing a new module, refactoring a complex file, splitting a monolith, or reviewing whether a codebase's structure is preventing safe change.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar ARCHITECT — deep-module design discipline: small interface, large implementation, clean seam, testable through that interface. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-codebase-design or works on module structure.
